summary: Quantum eMotion Corp filed a Form 6-K with Exhibit 99.1 announcing its sponsorship of the AI for Good Global Summit 2026 and participation in a cybersecurity panel. Additionally, the board approved a grant of 2,475,000 stock options to the CEO at $4.32 per share with a ten-year term, vesting in four annual installments. There are no M&A, shareholder activism, restructuring, or other special-situation elements; this is a routine current report on a non-material operational event.
